title: KylomaskGamer's Pack
description: KylomaskGamer's minecraft resource pack he usually uses
body:
# itsa a pack
its the pack ever

# version stuff
1.21.x is a recommendewd version, although, 1.20.x is also playable, but with these features **missing**:
- ui changes, such as buttons and sliders
- 
this mod will always be tested on 1.21.x 

 
# stuff
- font is fredoka
- vingette removed
- weapons are made in penguinmod
- TOTEM OF CHEESE
- a less calming ending text
- mockery on stuff AGAIn
  - examples include every iron-based item renamed to iron
  - reason: in one of my classes they did a trivia to name that minecraft block so the trivia was like in french so i said "minérail de fer" (thats iron ore in english), but the OTHERS they said "fer" (iron in english) and they accepted both, [THIS IS WHAT THEY SHOWED US](https://minecraft.wiki/images/thumb/Iron_Ore_JE1_BE1.png/512px-Iron_Ore_JE1_BE1.png?1e5e0)
- burger king for post credits
- credits rewritten (but the old credits are still there just swap out credits.json and oldcredits.json)
- death.accident.fell.water now has smth
- iron trapdoors are now amongus along with respective sounds from amongus
- tf2 crit sound
- 360 noscope i think
- retro click sound i think
- ENCHANTED WEAPONS ARE magical unicorns of magic
- i dare you to craft a netherite hoe, it has a surprise
- i thought i had minceraft but nvm
- end portal is literal
- pumpkin has a :)
- for hypixel skyblock players, cracked bricks are now red
- suspicious gravel is clear now

note, you must be in english (canada) to see language changes
